title: Genotype array data — SNV kinship
description: One element is one related pair of participants in the genotype array kinship file (ofh_snv_kinship.txt).

ID1.title: Participant ID for individual 1 in related pair
ID1.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID; that every PID exists there cannot be enforced across tables (D102). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

ID2.title: Participant ID for individual 2 in related pair
ID2.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID; that every PID exists there cannot be enforced across tables (D102). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

HetHet.title: HetHet proportion
HetHet.description: Fraction of markers for which the pair both have a heterozygous genotype (output from KING software).
HetHet.$comment: The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).

IBS0.title: Identity by State proportion
IBS0.description: Fraction of markers for which the pair shares zero alleles (output from KING software).
IBS0.$comment: The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).

Kinship.title: Kinship coefficient
Kinship.description: Estimate of the kinship coefficient for this pair based on the set of markers used in the kinship inference (output from KING software).
Kinship.$comment: The source states no range, so none is asserted (D024).
